pair.title: Nibe Live
pair.not_connected: Not connected to your heat pump

detect.title: Detecting features
detect.intro: Connecting to your heat pump and watching which values change. This takes about half a minute.
detect.failed: Can't read from your heat pump
detect.no_data: No NIBE data at this address. Check the IP address and that Modbus TCP is on (menu 7.5.9).

features.title: Select features
features.intro: Choose what to show. Ticked items have data from your heat pump.
features.insights_note: Turning off a feature also deletes its Insights history.

evidence.unsupported: not supported by your heat pump

sources.prompt: More than one sensor can report this. Choose the one to use:

devices.title: Add devices
devices.intro: Each function of your heat pump gets its own device in Homey. Ticked devices have live data.
devices.select_one: Select at least one device to add.
devices.main_desc: Overview: outdoor temperature, operating priority and mode, plus diagnostics and statistics
devices.analytics_desc: Helps the developer see which models and features are used and where setup fails. No personal data, readings or network details are sent. You can change this later in the app settings.

discover.title: Find your heat pump
discover.searching: Searching your network for NIBE heat pumps…
discover.confirm: Heat pump found. Tap to confirm.
discover.none_found: No heat pump found. Check that Modbus TCP is on (menu 7.5.9), or enter the IP address below.

tank.title: Hot water tank
tank.hint: Required for the hot water estimate. Choose your tank's series, such as VPB. The lining doesn't matter.

gateway.title: Gateway connection
gateway.hint: Choose how your gateway numbers NIBE Modbus address 40025. Not sure? Ask whoever set it up.
gateway.invalid: Choose a gateway, a port from 1–65535 and a Modbus ID from 1–247.
gateway.detect_intro: Checking the values your heat pump reports. This may take a few minutes, depending on the gateway.

firmware.title: Update your heat pump first
firmware.intro: Many features require recent software on your heat pump. Older versions lack some readings and can report wrong energy figures.
firmware.online_body: When an update is available, approve it in the myUplink app or on your heat pump's display. Swipe to the product overview and tap Update.
firmware.usb_body: Download the latest software from myuplink.com and put it on a USB stick. Insert it in the port above the display and open menu 8.1.
firmware.f_title: Via myUplink or a USB stick
firmware.f_body: The steps differ between models. See your heat pump's manual.
firmware.note: This takes a few minutes. Your settings are kept.

connection.moved: Nibe Live: your heat pump's IP address changed from __from__ to __to__. Its devices have been updated.
connection.address_in_use: Another paired heat pump already uses __host__.
